edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.population: adolescents and adults after EBV infection
edges.mechanism: EBV is thought to prime autoreactive B-cell and T-cell responses that later target myelin, making it one of the strongest mechanistic candidates in MS causation.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2026 Onpoaree cohort in World J Hepatol, which ties epstein-barr virus infection to multiple sclerosis in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
